description: Real pilot run: Llama 3.3 70B via Groq, 11-case demo set. Reported in the paper's Table 4.8-2 (Section 4.9 after the 4.8/4.9 split).

environment.note: See requirements-lock.txt for exact dependency versions used for this run.

known_limitations_of_this_archive: This manifest and results.csv were reconstructed from the console output of the interactive run (per-case status/score/latency), not from a saved raw-response log file. The GroqLlamaClient.create_tool_call() raw API response objects were not persisted to disk during this specific run.

Future pilot/full runs should set audit_log_path to write results/audit_log_groq.jsonl (hash-chained, includes model_id and output_hash per case) and additionally persist raw provider responses for full auditability -- this run's audit log was written but is not yet committed to this archive folder; commit it alongside this manifest when available.
n=11 is a pilot-scale demonstration subset (Section 4.4), not the paper's planned n~1,020 evaluation. Do not read these numbers as a production-reliability or model-ranking claim about Llama 3.3 70B.

aggregate.mean_latency_seconds_note: Original run reported mean latency 0.235s averaged over all 11 cases including 2 zero-latency safety-blocked cases; corrected inference-only latency should be recomputed by re-running with the current harness.py (fixed post-review to exclude blocked cases from latency/schema-fidelity denominators -- see CHANGELOG / git log).
